title: TJX is up ~8.6% today after a Q3 beat-and-raise. Is the off-pricethesis back on after a 17% slide?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Tickeron AI dug through today's movers and surfaced  
\[TJX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TJX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TJX/)) on a fiscal Q3 beat-and-raise.  
The stock is up about 8.6% today (Wednesday, Nov 18), around $141 vs  
Tuesday's $129.85 close.  
  
The catalyst: sales of $15.95B (+6%) vs \~$15.82B estimated, comps +4%,  
and adjusted EPS of $1.34, which came in ahead of plan. Management  
raised the full-year outlook. That bounce comes after the stock had  
fallen 17% from its August highs amid pre-earnings downgrades.  
  
What's next: holiday-quarter EPS guidance of $1.42–$1.45, and whether  
Marmaxx can keep reaccelerating.  
  
Full write-up: [https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-the-tjx-companies-tjx-stock-up-10-04-today-40385/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-the-tjx-companies-tjx-stock-up-10-04-today-40385/)  
  
Does this reset the off-price retail story into the holidays, or was  
this just a relief bounce after the 17% drawdown?
